case eviction/noeviction
> "SET" "a" "v"
2 "+OK\r\n"
3 "+OK\r\n"
~ "SET" "a" "v"
> "SET" "b" "v"
2 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
3 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
> "APPEND" "a" "x"
2 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
3 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
> "GET" "a"
2 "$1\r\nv\r\n"
3 "$1\r\nv\r\n"
> "MULTI"
2 "+OK\r\n"
3 "+OK\r\n"
> "SET" "b" "v"
2 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
3 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
> "GET" "a"
2 "+QUEUED\r\n"
3 "+QUEUED\r\n"
> "EXEC"
2 "-EXECABORT Transaction discarded because of previous errors.\r\n"
3 "-EXECABORT Transaction discarded because of previous errors.\r\n"
> "DEL" "a"
2 ":1\r\n"
3 ":1\r\n"
~ "DEL" "a"
> "SET" "b" "v"
2 "+OK\r\n"
3 "+OK\r\n"
~ "SET" "b" "v"
> "MSETEX" "1" "m" "v"
2 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
3 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
> "INCREX" "n" "BYINT" "1"
2 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
3 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
> "SET" "b" "v" "IFEQ" "x"
2 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
3 "-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'.\r\n"
> "DELEX" "b" "IFEQ" "v"
2 ":1\r\n"
3 ":1\r\n"
~ "DEL" "b"
> "CONFIG" "GET" "maxmemory-policy"
2 "*2\r\n$16\r\nmaxmemory-policy\r\n$10\r\nnoeviction\r\n"
3 "%1\r\n$16\r\nmaxmemory-policy\r\n$10\r\nnoeviction\r\n"

case eviction/volatile-lru
> "SET" "volatile" "v" "EX" "3600"
2 "+OK\r\n"
3 "+OK\r\n"
~ "SET" "volatile" "v"
~ "PEXPIREAT" "volatile" "4000003600000"
~ "DEL" "volatile"
> "EXISTS" "volatile"
2 ":0\r\n"
3 ":0\r\n"
> "SET" "kept" "v"
2 "+OK\r\n"
3 "+OK\r\n"
~ "SET" "kept" "v"
> "SET" "refused" "v"
